title: Sign in
welcome_body: Sign in to your company panel.
totp_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
social_totp_hint: Two-step verification is on for your account. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
link_body: Apple hid your e-mail address. Link an existing Rentopya account, or create a new one.
link_no_register: New accounts are closed right now. Link your existing account or ask your company for an invitation.
link_email_hint: The e-mail address of your Rentopya account. We will send a confirmation code to it.
link_code_hint: If an account uses {{email}}, a 6-digit code was sent to it.
pick_org_body: Which company's panel do you want to work in?
no_org_body: Your account is not linked to a company yet. Ask your company administrator for an invitation.
org_lost: You no longer have access to {{name}}. Choose another company.
